proof_body:
by
  intro a r K hr0 hr1 h
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1) ?_
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (max K 1)] with n hn
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := le_of_max_le_right hn
  have h1 := h n (le_of_max_le_left hn) hn1
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
  have h2 : |a n| = (|a n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ n := by
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (abs_nonneg _) (by omega)]
  rw [h2]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 n
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (K : ℕ), 0 ≤ r → r < 1 → (∀ n : ℕ, K ≤ n → 1 ≤ n → |a n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ r) → Summable (fun n => |a n|)
